hero.lead: To keep industrial facilities running safely and efficiently, Adanex Elektrik provides all the explosion-proof products and electrical equipment they need, with a professional engineering approach.

projects.zoneNote: Zone classification and product selection must be carried out by competent specialists for your specific facility.

lighting.title: Explosion-Proof Lighting Fixtures
lighting.summary: The new SEDEX series complies with ATEX and is used in Zone 2/22 environments. Lighting and emergency exit fixtures offer durability in harsh conditions.

controlBoxes.title: Explosion-Proof Control Boxes
controlBoxes.summary: ATEX/IECEx certified boxes available with Start, Stop, Emergency Stop, Locking Emergency Stop, signal lamp and cam switch variants. Enclosures are aluminium.

emergencyExit.title: Explosion-Proof Emergency Exit Fixtures
emergencyExit.summary: ATEX certified emergency exit fixtures suitable for Zone 1, 2, 21 and 22 environments.

cableGlands.title: E1W Explosion-Proof Armoured Brass Cable Gland
cableGlands.summary: ATEX certified armoured cable glands with brass, stainless steel and nickel-plated options. Used in refineries, petrochemical, paint and chemical plants and power stations.

floodlights.title: Zone 2/22 Explosion-Proof LED Floodlights
floodlights.summary: ATEX certified LED floodlights with impact-resistant housings. Used in areas such as refineries, food, pharmaceutical plants and power stations.

panels.title: Explosion-Proof Panels and Junction Boxes
panels.summary: Aluminium-bodied models, from compact terminal boxes to large windowed panels for contactors, relays and PLCs. Used in refineries, LNG/LPG, chemical plants, paint shops and gas filling sites.
